## Standing operator rules
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- Staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Current objective
- Fix JPY rounding so it has zero decimal places in `ledgerly/money.py`.
- Test Workflow migration remains in progress; PDF export migration is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 broke the Stripe client.
- Per-invoice embedding calls were too slow; bounded batching initially failed an exact-request-count test.

## Recent work
- Search rebuilds now share a batch embedder, batch requests, scope by tenant, and bulk-upsert vectors with a uniqueness migration; full suite passed 247 tests, 4 skipped. CSV exports now explicitly use UTF-8; all 7 CSV tests pass.
